steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json file defining the app name and package name format.

steps.title: Set Up Build System Environment
steps.description: Configure the AGP version, compilation parameters, and system build limits in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up application settings, relative launchers, standard material styling, and ensure correct schema declaration in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define Application Strings
steps.description: Set up general string assets in strings.xml for standardized use across configurations.

steps.title: Establish Color Profile
steps.description: Create colors.xml containing specific color hex values for income elements, expense elements, and primary branding teal color.

steps.title: Create Card Shape Layout
steps.description: Implement a drawable XML shape with bordered styling and subtle rounding to house clean overview blocks.

steps.title: Create Income Badge Style
steps.description: Establish a styled badge background for representing positive transactions with green elements.

steps.title: Create Expense Badge Style
steps.description: Establish a styled badge background for representing cost items with soft red indicators.

steps.title: Create Primary Rounded Button Shape
steps.description: Design a reusable primary action button shape with teal coloring and rounded borders.

steps.title: Design Application Dashboard and Tabs
steps.description: Develop a multi-view horizontal navigation layout containing a dynamic dashboard scrollview, transaction filters, and summaries in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Design Transaction List Element
steps.description: Construct list item rows to house category indicator badges, description text, timestamp, and numerical balance amounts in item_transaction.xml.

steps.title: Design Dialog Transaction Editor Form
steps.description: Build an editing popup container in dialog_add_transaction.xml with fields for amount, dynamic categorization selectors, and calendar selector input.

steps.title: Design Category Breakdown Report Rows
steps.description: Establish item_report_category.xml supporting layout percentage calculation bars utilizing relative visual weights.

steps.title: Build SQL Local Database Manager
steps.description: Develop DatabaseHelper.java to set up internal SQL schemas for standard default classifications, tracking transactions, and computing analytics.

steps.title: Implement Base Navigation Logic
steps.description: Develop main setup lifecycle events, layout toggle helpers, and dynamic navigation click handlers in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Transaction List Adaption
steps.description: Write a custom BaseAdapter inner class inside MainActivity.java supporting row populating, item identification, and transaction coloring rules.

steps.title: Implement Popup Dialog Form Functionality
steps.description: Write custom handlers inside MainActivity.java to prompt dialog inputs, support custom dynamic category creations, and apply calendar selection overlays.

steps.title: Implement Filters and Month Breakdowns
steps.description: Incorporate automated filter spinners on the History and Reports layout to partition transactions by month or grouping.

steps.title: Implement Category Weight Progress Bar
steps.description: Construct mathematical layout scaling parameters that dynamically adjust category spending visual widths based on percentage totals.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker
steps.description: Assemble files and compile build environment parameters to generate an absolute APK application package.
